correctness.rationale: The corrected RESULT retains the mathematical trichotomy and supplies independent computations of its decisive spectral and quartic inputs. Logistic forcing in (0,1), linear damping and global Lipschitz bounds give bounded global forward solutions, with the precise invariant cube [0,1/v]^3. Taking differences gives an autonomous sum-zero plane, and a zero difference at an equilibrium forces all differences to vanish. Otherwise v s−φ(s) has the sign of s for v≥1, so the equilibrium signs would alternate around an odd cycle. Strict rearrangement for ψ(s)=s−φ(s) gives T(d)>0 off zero since equality under the cyclic shift requires a constant triple. The exact balance R′/2=(3/2−v)R−T controls the whole plane; above threshold T/R=O(R) near zero is integrable, giving a strictly positive rescaled limit. At threshold a positive limiting radius contradicts strict dissipation on a compact annulus. Each entry of d is a root of u³−(R/2)u−d_1d_2d_3, so the cubic contraction entering T gives exactly 3R²/4 before multiplication by 4/3. Thus (1/R)′→2 and the coefficient is 1/2 in the original time. Below threshold the smaller disk has outward radial derivative bounded below by a positive multiple of R, so every nonzero trajectory stays eventually outside and no equilibrium can lie in its compact omega limit. Poincaré–Bendixson gives a periodic difference orbit, and the stable driven mean has only one bounded entire response over each translate of it; this yields distance convergence to the lifted orbit without claiming phase convergence or uniqueness. The frozen verify.py uses finite rational grid checks (not a polynomial certificate as originally described) and its eigenvalue assertion uses inserted values. The repaired verification notes preserve its limited diagnostic role and do not rely on running it.

value.rationale: Even after crediting strict secant attraction and the known numerical cycle example, there is an exact normalization-sensitive limit at loss of stability, and a globally quantified oscillatory conclusion rather than a local bifurcation or finite-time plot. The invariant-plane energy calculation explains why the coefficient is universal across nonsynchronous initial conditions. These features make the result a useful sharp dynamical benchmark at a parameter where strict stability criteria stop, with no claim about period, uniqueness, or physical implementation.
